qualification_boundary: Exact-head CI qualifies catalog integrity, corrected live authority pinning, permanent-case deduplication, coverage, hard-mass metadata, bounded pairwise/risk selection and support-only diff. Each physics case remains separately executable/admissible only with owner evidence.
defect_policy: Do not repair source defects in F-TB09; route any discovered defect to a separate owner workunit.
close_condition: The successful workflow must verify the live branch ref equals GITHUB_SHA both before and after validation. No later commit may be added without rerunning exact-head CI.
